steps.title: After light Rampant cast starts
steps.rule: Go to 6m north of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 7m north-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 6m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 7m south-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 6m south of the centre.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → E wall; false → W wall.

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: InitiallySteeped has MeleeDpsA).

steps.title: After a tether lands on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Go to 7m north-east of the centre.

OffTank.rule: If you are in Weights: Go to 7m south-east of the centre; otherwise: Go to 7m north-east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → NW 7m; true & no → NW 7m; false & no → near A (N 7m).

ShieldHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out MT, stand near waymark A, 7m north of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to 7m north-east of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes MT, stand near waymark A, 7m north of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Weights includes OT, stand near waymark C, 7m south of the centre; when Weights leaves out OT, go to 7m south-east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has CasterDps and Pairs: no & true → SW 7m; no & false → near C (S 7m); yes & true → near C (S 7m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: When Chained leaves out OT, stand near waymark C, 7m south of the centre; when Chained includes OT, go to 7m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to 7m south-west of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to 7m north-west of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes OT, go to 7m south-west of the centre.

steps.title: After a tether lands on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

OffTank.rule: If you are in Weights: Go to the south-east wall; otherwise: Go to the north-west wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → NE wall; true & no → NE wall; false & no → S wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the south wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the north-west wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes MT, go to the south wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Weights includes OT, go to the north wall; when Weights leaves out OT, go to the south-east wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has CasterDps and Pairs: no & true → SW wall; no & false → N wall; yes & true → N wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: When Chained leaves out OT, go to the north wall; when Chained includes OT, go to the south-east wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the south-west wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the north-east wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes OT, go to the south-west wall.

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: Stand near waymark D, 13m west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → near B (E 13m); false → near D (W 13m).

OffTank.rule: Stand near waymark B, 13m east of the centre.

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: InitiallySteeped has MeleeDpsA).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark B, 13m east of the centre.

steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

OffTank.rule: If you are in Weights: Go to the south wall; otherwise: Go to the north wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → N wall; true & no → N wall; false & no → S wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the south wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the north wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes MT, go to the south wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Weights includes OT, go to the north wall; when Weights leaves out OT, go to the south wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has CasterDps and Pairs: no & true → S wall; no & false → N wall; yes & true → N wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: When Chained leaves out OT, go to the north wall; when Chained includes OT, go to the south wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the south wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the north wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes OT, go to the south wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → S wall; false → N wall.

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: InitiallySteeped has MeleeDpsA).

steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

OffTank.rule: If you are in Weights: Go to the south wall; otherwise: Go to the north wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → N wall; true & no → N wall; false & no → S wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the south wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out MT, go to the north wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes MT, go to the south wall.

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Weights includes OT, go to the north wall; when Weights leaves out OT, go to the south wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has CasterDps and Pairs: no & true → S wall; no & false → N wall; yes & true → N wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: When Chained leaves out OT, go to the north wall; when Chained includes OT, go to the south wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the south wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out OT, go to the north wall; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights includes OT, go to the south wall.

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has MeleeDpsA and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → N wall; yes & true → NE wall; no & false → N wall; no & true → S wall.

OffTank.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Chained has MainTank: false & yes → SW wall; true & yes → S wall; true & no → NE wall; false & no → SW wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → N wall; true & no → NE wall; false & no → SW wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → SW wall; true & no → S wall; false & no → N wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WeightSlot).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Chained has PhysRangedDps: false & no → N wall; true & yes → S wall; false & yes → SW wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has OffTank and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → N wall; no & true → S wall; no & false → SW wall; yes & true → S wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has OffTank and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → SW wall; no & true → NE wall; no & false → N wall; yes & true → NE wall.

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has MeleeDpsA and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → NE wall; yes & true → N wall; no & false → NE wall; no & true → SW wall.

OffTank.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Chained has MainTank: false & yes → S wall; true & yes → SW wall; true & no → N wall; false & no → S wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → NE wall; true & no → N wall; false & no → S wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Weights has MeleeDpsB: false & yes → S wall; true & no → SW wall; false & no → NE wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WeightSlot).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on NorthOrbsFirst and Chained has PhysRangedDps: false & no → NE wall; true & yes → SW wall; false & yes → S wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has OffTank and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → NE wall; no & true → SW wall; no & false → S wall; yes & true → SW wall.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has OffTank and NorthOrbsFirst: yes & false → S wall; no & true → N wall; no & false → NE wall; yes & true → N wall.

steps.title: After lightsteeped on you
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Depends on InitiallySteeped has MainTank and NorthOrbsFirst: no & false → centre; no & true → centre; yes & false → NE 6m; yes & true → near A (N 7m).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: InitiallySteeped has OffTank).

RegenHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights includes M2, go to 6m north-east of the centre; when InitiallySteeped includes H1 and Weights leaves out M2, stand near waymark A, 7m north of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out H1 and Weights leaves out M2, stand at the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: When InitiallySteeped leaves out H2 and Chained includes H2, stand at the centre; when InitiallySteeped includes H2 and Chained leaves out H2, go to 6m north-east of the centre; when InitiallySteeped includes H2 and Chained includes H2, go to 6m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WeightSlot).

MeleeDpsB.rule: When InitiallySteeped leaves out MT and Weights includes M2, go to 6m north-east of the centre; when InitiallySteeped leaves out MT and Weights leaves out M2, go to 6m south-west of the centre; when InitiallySteeped includes MT and Weights leaves out M2, stand at the centre; when InitiallySteeped includes MT and Weights includes M2, stand near waymark C, 7m south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: InitiallySteeped has PhysRangedDps).

CasterDps.rule: If you are in InitiallySteeped: Stand near waymark A, 7m north of the centre; otherwise: Stand at the centre.

steps.title: After bright Hunger resolves
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → near 1 (NW 7m); false → near A (N 8m).

OffTank.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → near 2 (NE 7m); false → near B (E 8m).

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → near 4 (SW 7m); false → near D (W 8m).

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on Pairs: true → near 3 (SE 7m); false → near C (S 8m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 7m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 7m north-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 7m north-east of the centre.

steps.title: After banish III resolves
steps.rule: Each role has its own spot.

MainTank.rule: Stand near waymark A, 8m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Stand near waymark B, 8m east of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Stand near waymark D, 8m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark C, 8m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 7m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 7m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, 7m north-west of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, 7m north-east of the centre.
